title: Creep
notes: Also the title of well-known songs by TLC and Stone Temple Pilots. ISRC: the only ISRC on MusicBrainz recording 70595637 (1992). Recorded as an interpolation of the composition: the article says "They took elements from the 1972 song 'The Air That I Breathe' by Albert Hammond and Mike Hazlewood" and "The chord progression and melody in 'Creep' are similar to those of" that song, after which Hammond and Hazlewood were credited as co-writers. No recording is sampled; the target is given by title and first recording artist. Not in the live subset, so its Wikipedia-sourced interpolation is listed in otherDocumentedTargets instead of gold; the README explains how borrowings described without a named type are recorded.
